newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted steady to up on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted steady to up on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to higher levels on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session in bids and offers. No barges traded versus no trades on Friday, exchange sources said.
- Two barges, this week, mid-Mississippi River, Clinton and South, Load and Release by Dec 3, $250 a day thereafter, no bid, offered 200 percent of tariff, 10 percentage points higher than Friday.
- Two barges next week, mid-Mississippi, Clinton and South, Load and Release by December 3, $250 per day thereafter, no bid, offered 200 percent.
- Two barges, next week, Illinois River, bid 157-1/2 percent of tariff, no offer.
- 10 barges, two each week December, Illinois River, bid 155 percent, up five percentage points, similar, offered one each at 165 percent, up 10 percentage points, similar.
- 10 barges, two each week December, Lower Ohio River, bid 125 percent, offer 140 percent.
